name: Forest Tents (Forest Department)
distance: Near Balloon No. 5 behind Kalyana Katta (Medaram)
amenities_and_facilities: 100 comfortable tents set up in a 1-acre clearing by the Forest Department.
Dedicated mobile freshwater toilet van provided for every 10 tents.
Fire extinguisher safety setup available at every tent.
description: 100 official Forest Tents set up behind Kalyana Katta near Balloon No. 5 for devotees listening to the veneration.
